proposed_ready_predicate.request_id: The inbound request_id is not the empty string, and the candidate request_id equals it.
authentication_qualifier: row.evidence_ref is not the empty string
row.session_id is not the empty string
route_qualifier: row.route_id is not the empty string
row.scope_evidence_ref is not the empty string
row.required_permission.resource is not the empty string
row.required_permission.action is not the empty string
row.required_permission.scope is not the empty string
proposed_ready_predicate.uniqueness: Exactly one list entry satisfies each qualifier; duplicate equal entries count separately.
proposed_ready_predicate.same_row_provenance: Candidate session_id equals the unique qualifying authentication row session_id; candidate required_permission resource, action and scope and scope_evidence_ref equal the unique qualifying route row values.

separating_examples.condition: Nonempty request ID, one qualifying row in each list, and every candidate value from those same rows.
Otherwise READY context, but inbound and matching candidate request IDs are empty.
One qualifying row and one nonqualifying row exist; candidate value comes from the nonqualifying row.
Two equal qualifying list entries are present in either resolver list.
